subject: Kernel SRE geo rebalance request — reallocate seat to EU cluster
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kernel SRE geo rebalance request — reallocate seat to EU cluster

Hi all,

We have an opportunity to accelerate kernel-level SRE coverage in EMEA by converting one US-headcount-approved runtime slot into a permanent EU seat (Frankfurt region). The core rationale:

- Observability & latency: recent production regressions showed increased page-fault/IO sensitivity for long-tail workloads originating in EU; having core SREs nearby reduces mean-time-to-fix.
- Hiring velocity: we have two active senior Kernel SRE candidates in the EU market who fit our comp bands and could start ~Q1 2027.
- Cost neutrality: reassigning an existing open slot avoids an incremental headcount add; attached is a quick cost model (cost_model_v2.pdf) and seat movement table (seat_rebalance_table.xlsx).

Ask: approve moving one open runtime slot (headcount ID HR-7891) from US pool to EU and allow Rachel to extend offers once HR confirms band parity. If approved, I’ll coordinate with Marissa to update the req, and with Marcus for any impact to team stretch goals.

Relevant details attached: JD for the role, a one-page impact summary, and a suggested offer band aligned to current senior Kernel SRE ranges.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marcus: quick OK on scope impact (does moving the seat break any committed deliverables?)
2) Kimberly / Finance: confirm budget neutral from Q4 reforecast or direction on ledger reallocation
3) Marissa / HR: update req location and candidate outreach cadence

Thanks — I tried to keep this tight. Happy to jump on a 20-min sync if that helps.

—
Mina Haddad
Director, Runtime Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: seat_rebalance_table.xlsx (spreadsheet), cost_model_v2.pdf (pdf), JD-kernel-sre-senior.md (text)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kernel SRE geo rebalance request — reallocate seat to EU cluster

Mina — thanks for the clear write-up. Quick notes from my side:

- Scope: I don’t anticipate any blocker to moving the slot. The kernel team's current roadmap has buffer; we can absorb the rotation if the hire lands in Q1.
- Capacity: We should confirm rotation/oncall coverage remains balanced across timezones — suggest adding a rollover plan to the hiring packet.
- Comp bands: I need a clear mapping to existing senior Kernel SRE bands (total comp, target bonus, equity).

Kimberly — please confirm whether Finance needs a formal reclassification (US->EU) and whether any headcount charge codes need migration; if there’s a timing issue, we can treat this as a location swap vs an extra FTE.

If everyone is OK, I’ll mark this as green from Platform and expect Marissa + Rachel to proceed with the req update and outreach.

-Marcus
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kernel SRE geo rebalance request — reallocate seat to EU cluster

Thanks Mina — read the attachments. Two quick finance items:

1) Headcount classification: we can treat this as a geographic reallocation of an existing approved headcount (no incremental FTE) provided the role is filled within the same fiscal year and total run-rate is neutral. Please ensure the seat_rebalance_table shows the ledger reallocation lines — Finance will need the charge-code mapping before payroll runs.

2) Compensation parity: EU gross target differs from US gross due to benefits and local taxes; compensation band must be presented in on-target TC for EU. Marissa/Rachel — please confirm the proposed TC in JD-kernel-sre-senior.md includes local on-target numbers.

Operational ask: once you have candidate names, route the offer paperwork via People Ops and put a small note for Finance to approve the final band. Assuming the cost_model looks as advertised, I’m comfortable approving in principle.

—
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference
